name: Claude for CA
description: Claude Code plugins for Indian Chartered Accountant firms — GST compliance, income tax, TDS/TCS, audit, MCA/secretarial, transfer pricing, FEMA, payroll, advisory, client onboarding, CA student hub, and firm management. Includes offline memory bank and financial integrity guardrails with Human-in-the-Loop checkpoints.
author: EurthTech

plugins.description: Core plugin: offline memory bank (SQLite), financial integrity guardrails (HITL hooks), audit trail, and compliance calendar monitors. Required by all domain plugins.
One-time firm onboarding + client registration. Writes firm profile, partner details, client registry to local SQLite.
Email invoice fetch, PDF data extraction, bank statement processing, Tally import builder.
GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, ITC reconciliation, GST notice triage, GSTR-9/9C annual return, GST audit (Sec 65/66).
ITR review, IT notice analysis, advance tax, capital gains, Form 3CD tax audit, search & survey.
TDS default check, 26AS reconciliation, Form 16/16A generator, 24Q/26Q quarterly return review.
CARO 2020 (21 clauses), SA-315 risk matrix, bank audit & LFAR, workpapers, internal audit.
ROC filing tracker (AOC-4, MGT-7, DPT-3), board resolutions, annual compliance, charge registry.
Form 3CEB (all 25+ paragraphs), TP documentation (Rule 10D), FAR analysis, benchmarking study.
FDI compliance (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, FEMA 20R, FLA return), ODI compliance (APR annual return).
PF ECR generation, ESIC half-yearly return, state-wise Professional Tax (KA, MH, TN, AP, WB, GJ).
Tax planning (old vs new regime, 80C-80U), MSME advisory (Udyam, 43B(h), MSME Samadhaan).
KYC checklist (individual/company/LLP), SA-210 engagement letters, PMLA CDD compliance.
Articleship diary (ICAI area-wise hours tracker), CA exam preparation (Foundation/Inter/Final).
Fee tracker, outstanding invoice aging, collection reminders, monthly practice review.
Plugin discovery and navigation. Entry point for users who don't know which skill to use.
